items.headline: Deshawn Purdie, Kam Davis lead Liberty in overwhelming 49-10 rout of FIU
items.description: — Deshawn Purdie threw for 227 yards and a touchdown, and Kam Davis ran for two scores as Liberty overwhelmed Florida International 49-10 on Saturday.

items.description: — Terrence Brown rushed for 158 yards and a touchdown, and Dominic Bourgeois made four field goals as Middle Tennessee held off Florida International 26-23 on Tuesday night.
